test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

She use to learn fabric painting when she was in middle school.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'use' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be **'used to'** **to indicate a habitual action in the past.**
 
 
• **​**That light house over there **used to** belong to my family.
 
• I didn't use to be a vegetarian but nowadays I do use.
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is: ***She used to__ learn fabric painting when she was in middle school*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase **'used to'** is commonly used to **describe an action that was regularly performed in the past but is no longer done in the present**.
 
• Example: *I** used to **play the piano when I was a child.*
